summary: ACDC #192 决定 Glamsterdam 按现有规范上线，保留 EIP-8037 状态创建重新定价，Hoodi 测试网定于 2026-12-15 19:12 UTC 升级。账户层新合并 EIP-8476（EOA 永久退出 EIP-7702 委托）和 EIP-8425 的种子证明恢复方案，EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM 在主网字节码测试后被提议加两条限制。Hegotá 是否保留 FOCIL、全力做后量子，要到约 12 月 10 日的 ACDC 才定。

items.title_en: Ethlabs posted its position on Glamsterdam
items.note_en: On Magicians at 2026-11-26 03:26 (caspar), recommending going ahead with the current spec. Most of the disruption comes from repricing state creation, which it calls a necessary step toward 1000x scaling. Pulling EIP-8037 would give up Glamsterdam's roughly 3x higher gas limit and only push the problem to a later fork. The new state gas reservoir is a secondary source of breakage, and changing the EIP would help only some affected projects at the cost of more months of delay. Ethlabs' X post (2026-11-26 04:38) gives the background: an October audit found the repricings break assumptions some deployed contracts rely on, and the rollout was paused.

items.title: EIP-8476 Permanent EOA Delegation Opt-Out
items.note: 2026-11-27 09:17 合并为 Draft Core EIP（nicolashw）。EOA 通过一种原本无效、被严格限定的 set-code 交易写入 3 字节标记 0xef0200，之后任何委托授权（包括清除授权）都不能替换它；EVM 把标记当作空代码（EXTCODESIZE 为 0），合约看到的仍是普通 EOA。动机是交易所热钱包、机构和金库这类账户不需要 7702，委托执行会破坏它们链下风控的假设。它只关掉委托，私钥泄露后仍能签普通交易。
items.note_en: Was merged as a Draft Core EIP at 2026-11-27 09:17 (nicolashw). Using a narrowly constrained, previously invalid form of set-code transaction, an EOA writes the 3-byte marker 0xef0200, after which no delegation authorization, including a clearing one, can replace it. The EVM treats the marker as empty code (EXTCODESIZE is 0), so contracts still see an ordinary EOA. The motivation is that exchange hot wallets, institutions and treasuries do not need 7702, and delegated execution can undermine the assumptions behind their offchain controls. It only removes delegation; a leaked key can still sign normal transactions.

items.title: EIP-8425 Quantum Freeze and Account Recovery 更新
items.note: 2026-11-27 22:12 合并（colinlyguo）。按作者在 Magicians 的说明（2026-11-27 20:41）：去掉冻结前的恢复承诺和单独截止期，改用 EIP-8298 迁移；种子证明绑定 (chain_id, account, nonce, source, code_hash)，账户装上常规代码后种子恢复永久结束；冻结范围扩展到 EIP-8141 的 SECP256K1 条目，保留 P256VERIFY 和 EIP-8141 P256。是否以及何时启用冻结仍由社区单独决定。
items.title_en: EIP-8425 Quantum Freeze and Account Recovery update
items.note_en: Merged at 2026-11-27 22:12 (colinlyguo). Per the author's Magicians post (2026-11-27 20:41), pre-freeze recovery commitments and their separate cutoff are gone in favor of EIP-8298 migration. Seed proofs are bound to (chain_id, account, nonce, source, code_hash), seed recovery ends permanently once regular code is installed, and the freeze now also covers EIP-8141 SECP256K1 entries while keeping P256VERIFY and EIP-8141 P256. Whether and when to activate a freeze remains a separate community decision.

items.title: CPerezz 在 ethresear.ch 用主网字节码测试 EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM
items.note: （2026-11-27 15:11），对应 PR #12716（开放中）。发现两点：执行 SETCODEFROM 的帧仍在跑旧代码，而外部已看到新代码（“展示一套、运行另一套”，文中举了 sudoswap v1 路由按代码前 73 字节识别 pair 的例子）；借来的代码可以替换掉你的代码。提议代码变更延后生效，并只允许从账户自己的代码采用。
items.title_en: CPerezz tested EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM against mainnet bytecode on ethresear.ch
items.note_en: (2026-11-27 15:11), with the matching PR #12716 (open). Two problems surfaced: the frame running SETCODEFROM keeps executing its old code while everyone else already sees the new code ("show one code, run another", illustrated with sudoswap v1's router, which recognizes pairs by the first 73 bytes of their code), and borrowed code can replace your own. The proposal defers the code change and only allows adopting from the account's own code.

The post says bogota-devnet-2 already exercises EIP-8141, EIP-8298 and EIP-8151. This gives data to lightclient's PROOF frame PR #12714.

items.title: ERC-8441 混合后量子隐身地址
items.note: 隐私：ERC-8441 混合后量子隐身地址 出现独立 TypeScript 实现，29 组官方向量全部匹配（2026-11-26 18:41），作者 namncc 表示正在修订以加入 KEM 可替换性。siriusthemaster 的 ethresear.ch 文章（2026-11-27 20:35）指出，ERC-5564 schemeId 1 的隐身输出在量子攻击下比从未使用过的 EOA 更危险，量子对手仅凭公开数据就能关联并盗取未花费输出，并列出钱包现在能堵的两个漏洞（付款方回收、由 ECDSA 签名派生的密钥）。
items.note_en: Privacy: ERC-8441 hybrid post-quantum stealth addresses got an independent TypeScript implementation that matches all 29 official test vector rows (2026-11-26 18:41), and author namncc said the ERC is being revised to add KEM agility. siriusthemaster's ethresear.ch post (2026-11-27 20:35) argues that ERC-5564 schemeId 1 stealth outputs are worse off than never-used EOAs against a quantum adversary, who could link and steal unspent outputs from public data alone, and lists two holes wallets can close today (payer clawback and keys derived from ECDSA signatures).

items.topic: Hegotá 重新定范围：FOCIL 和后量子争资源
items.title: fradamt
items.note: （2026-11-25 23:07）和 caspar（2026-11-26 12:53）主张为了尽快实现后量子和抗 AI 安全（pqai），Hegotá 暂时放弃 FOCIL，理由是两者争夺同一批高上下文的核心开发者。nflaig 反对（2026-11-26 19:07）：交易供应链中心化在加剧，没有 FOCIL 扩容会受限，Lodestar 已在主干合并完整实现。trent_vanepps 称（2026-11-26 00:56）Ethlabs 已撤回 EIP-8198 Quick Slots 的提案；potuz 则认为（2026-11-26 02:35）PQ 分叉会引入新攻击面，名字里的 “ai” 不必要。
items.note_en: (2026-11-25 23:07) and caspar (2026-11-26 12:53) argued that to make Ethereum secure against quantum and AI threats (pqai) as fast as possible, Hegotá should drop FOCIL for now, since both draw on the same small group of high-context core devs. nflaig disagreed (2026-11-26 19:07): transaction supply chain centralization keeps growing, scaling is limited without FOCIL, and Lodestar has already merged a complete implementation to its trunk. trent_vanepps said (2026-11-26 00:56) Ethlabs has withdrawn EIP-8198 Quick Slots from consideration, while potuz argued (2026-11-26 02:35) that a PQ fork adds new attack surface and the "ai" in pqai is unnecessary.
items.topic_en: Rescoping Hegotá: FOCIL and post-quantum compete for the same people

items.title: barnabasbusa 在 ACDC 议程下提出 “FOCIL light”
items.note: （2026-11-26 20:20）：EIP-7805 只对 legacy、2930、1559、7702 交易强制包含，Frame 交易可以进入包含列表但被遗漏总是可以豁免；他同时说在此之前不能弃用 ECDSA，因为 EOA 是唯一抗审查路径。
items.title_en: barnabasbusa proposed "FOCIL light" on the ACDC agenda
items.note_en: (2026-11-26 20:20): EIP-7805 would enforce inclusion only for legacy, 2930, 1559 and 7702 transactions, and frame transactions could appear in inclusion lists but omitting them would always be excused. He added that until then ECDSA must not be deprecated, because EOAs are the only censorship resistant path.
items.topic_en: Rescoping Hegotá: FOCIL and post-quantum compete for the same people

items.title: jihoonsong 提出按研究、开发、测试流水线排期
items.note: （2026-11-26 19:47）：PQ 共识（PQ Gasper 或 PQ Decoupled Consensus）仍在研究阶段，PQ 预注册可以在 Glamsterdam 后不久先上。他在 ethresear.ch 的文章（2026-11-25 19:30）说明 FOCIL 在 PQ 过渡期依然可用，8 KiB 的包含列表能装下一笔带 leanSPHINCS 签名（7,740 B）的交易。
items.title_en: jihoonsong proposed scheduling by the research, development and testing pipeline
items.note_en: (2026-11-26 19:47): PQ consensus (PQ Gasper or PQ Decoupled Consensus) is still in research, and PQ preregistration could ship shortly after Glamsterdam. His ethresear.ch post (2026-11-25 19:30) explains that FOCIL keeps working through the PQ transition, and an 8 KiB inclusion list can carry one transaction with a leanSPHINCS signature (7,740 B).

items.title: PQ-CL Breakout #5
items.note: 进展：PQ-CL Breakout #5（EIPsInsight 笔记 2026-11-28 01:56）称 PQ devnet-1 已启动，8 个 CL 客户端全部参与，下一个 devnet 测试分段证明广播；terencechain 称（2026-11-27 21:08）devnet-1 参与率接近完美。ACDC #192 没有决定 FOCIL 去留，完整的 Hegotá 范围预计在约 12 月 10 日的 ACDC 决定。同时 FOCIL 规范继续推进：EIP-7805 rebase 合并（2026-11-28 00:03）。
items.note_en: Progress: PQ-CL Breakout #5 (EIPsInsight notes, 2026-11-28 01:56) reports that PQ devnet-1 launched with all 8 CL clients, and the next devnet will test segmented proof broadcast. terencechain said (2026-11-27 21:08) participation on devnet-1 is near perfect. ACDC #192 made no decision on FOCIL, and the full Hegotá scope is expected at the ACDC call around December 10. Meanwhile the FOCIL spec keeps moving: the EIP-7805 rebase was merged (2026-11-28 00:03).

items.title: Nero_eth：区块到底能有多大
items.note: （2026-11-22 发布，11-25 推广）：Glamsterdam 定价下最大的区块来自零字节 calldata 加上数千个被跳过的 EIP-7702 授权，60M gas 时约 1.8 MiB；建议按字节计 gas 并由 gas 上限推导 CL 大小上限。
items.title_en: Nero_eth: how big can a block get
items.note_en: (posted 2026-11-22, shared 11-25). Under Glamsterdam pricing the largest block comes from zero-byte calldata plus thousands of skipped EIP-7702 authorizations, about 1.8 MiB at 60M gas. He suggests pricing every payload byte in gas and deriving the CL size bound from the gas limit.

summary_en: ACDC #192 agreed to ship Glamsterdam with its current spec, keeping the EIP-8037 state creation repricing, and scheduled the Hoodi testnet upgrade for 2026-12-15 19:12 UTC. On the account side, EIP-8476 (a permanent EOA opt-out from EIP-7702 delegation) and the seed-proof recovery update to EIP-8425 were merged, while mainnet bytecode tests led to two proposed restrictions on EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM. Whether Hegotá keeps FOCIL or goes all in on post-quantum work will be decided at the ACDC call around December 10.
